title: AI Engineer, Agents
text:
Pathfinder Labs builds AI agents that automate back-office work for mid-size companies.

What you'll work on
- Design agentic workflows with LLMs: tool calling, planning, memory and retries.
- Build agent infrastructure in Python and TypeScript: FastAPI services, Celery workers, Redis queues.
- Integrate the OpenAI API and open models served with vLLM; measure cost and latency.
- Build evaluation harnesses (evals) and observability for agents in production.
- Work with Playwright to let agents operate web apps.
- Store and search knowledge with embeddings in Weaviate or pgvector.

You might be a fit if
- You've shipped LLM features to real users.
- You write clean, tested Python (pytest) and understand async programming.
- You're comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes and GCP.
- Startup experience preferred. Equity-heavy compensation.
